summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements and investments in the field, with a focus on AI security, agentic AI, and the expanding role of AI in various industries. Notable developments include the launch of new AI security tools and alliances, as well as breakthroughs in AI-driven drug discovery and robotics.
insight: The increasing emphasis on AI security and safety underscores the growing recognition of the need for responsible AI development and deployment, as the technology becomes more pervasive and powerful.
